name: agent-idle
description: Ambient desktop pet for developers, fed by real Claude Code usage.

scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @agent-idle/engine build && concurrently -k -n convex,turbo,daemon -c blue,green,magenta "convex dev" "turbo run dev" "pnpm --filter @agent-idle/cli dev:daemon"
scripts.dev:web: node scripts/link-sprites.mjs && pnpm --filter @agent-idle/engine build && pnpm --filter @agent-idle/cli build && concurrently -k -n convex,engine,app,cli,daemon -c blue,gray,green,cyan,magenta "convex dev" "pnpm --filter @agent-idle/engine dev" "pnpm --filter @agent-idle/app dev:vite" "pnpm --filter @agent-idle/cli dev" "pnpm --filter @agent-idle/cli dev:daemon"
scripts.ci: pnpm lint:engine-purity && turbo run typecheck && pnpm convex:typecheck && turbo run test
